$comment: Wave 13 performance budgets. Every number here is a CLAIM this platform is asserting, not a measured
baseline -- the first load gate run produces the measurement, and these values must then be revised to
match reality or the platform tightened. A budget nobody chose is not a budget; that is why this file
exists instead of defaults in code.
Targets are deliberately cheap endpoints: a load gate that hammers a database write path measures the
load generator more than the platform. If these hold, the interesting paths are worth measuring next.

scenarios.name: health endpoint under read load
scenarios.$comment: Unauthenticated liveness. A p95 above 250ms here means the process is not keeping up at all.

scenarios.name: API docs served from memory
scenarios.$comment: Swagger UI is a static document; this should be trivially fast and catches per-request allocation regressions.
